chunks: Indeed, when Allah, Blessed and Exalted, intends good for a servant, He does not cause him to die until He shows him the successor.

key_terms.إِنَّ: Indeed; a particle of emphasis introducing the statement
key_terms.الْخَلَفَ: The successor; the one who comes after him
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ: Blessed; indicating divine exaltedness and abundance of blessing
key_terms.خَيْرًا: Good; divine favor and benefit intended for the servant
key_terms.عَبْدٍ: A servant; a human being under Allah's care
key_terms.يُمِتْهُ: Cause him to die; bring about his death

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah intends good for a servant before his death?
ai.summary: This hadith states that among the signs of divine good for a servant is that Allah allows him to witness the one who will succeed him. It highlights continuity through offspring or succession as a blessing granted before death.
